body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_{2,\mathrm{loc}}\), \(n>4r\), \(i\in I_n\), and \(w\in\{1,2\}\), the restriction coupling satisfies \(Z_{n,i}^{(w)}=Z_i^{(w)}\) almost surely, and \(|\Lambda_n\setminus I_n|/|\Lambda_n|=2r/n\to0\).
body.justification: The exact interior coupling makes one buffered F\o lner sequence the sole finite-to-infinite-volume regime.
body.gap: BaryshnikovYukich2005 studies stabilizing finite-volume scores, while this proposition records the boundary deletion for two repeated exposure experiments on a fixed local graph.
body.consumer: An online experimenter can implement the diagnostic after dropping a prespecified fixed-width endpoint buffer.
